Atom labels were resolved only by cropping and upscaling, and the subscripts in SO2CH3, CF3 and CH2 are inferred from the label shape plus repetition across the five drawings rather than read glyph by glyph.
The two-letter reagent label above the first arrow of scheme (vi′-1) at approximately x=620-660, y=1380 in the page image is at the limit of resolution; read as CO, medium confidence.
The carbonyl-substituent label on the third structure of scheme (vi-1) (row 1, rightmost, approximately x=1150, y=1050) is smaller than its counterpart in scheme (vi); read as Cl, medium confidence.
